claim: A healthy two-goal run records normally; a no-change act produces no cache entry and invokes the executor on both runs; direct ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED returns action-uncertain with the action detail and exactly one committed action.

task.path_reachability: The healthy run establishes the fixture. Noop has a passing act with no screen change, so no entry should exist on either run. U1 calls replayTrace directly with a committed-but-unknown action.

arms.fault: no-op act with no state change
direct replay action commits then throws ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED

witness.delivery: Active variants are checked before dispatch. Executor invocations are appended only by runStep. report.json supplies cache mode/reason and write outcome. U1 separately checks stopReason, uncertainAction and the committed call count.
witness.checker: Executor invocation counter, cache entry count, cache mode/write, and direct replayTrace outcome.
blind_spots: The custom executor is deterministic code, not an LLM.
U1 tests replayTrace directly, not the complete StepTraceSession or a real provider.
No-change checks one no-op action only and does not prove all no-change forms.
Experiments use npm releases, not main.

grading.rubric: Preregistered cache/write behavior, executor count and direct uncertain outcome must agree; environment failures are INVALID.

invalid_rules: Browser, CDP endpoint, local app or dependency unavailable before a product verdict.
Config or executor setup failure before the first action.
Active variant differs from the preregistered setup.
Missing report, executor log or direct uncertain outcome required for adjudication.

isolation.mode: Local static app, temporary CDP Chrome, arm-specific caches, telemetry disabled; no real model, mobile, cloud browser or GitHub reporter.
isolation.contamination: Fixture sources remain on disk but the deterministic executor only observes the browser and never reads them. Each arm has an isolated cache directory.

ethics.blast_radius: Four local test executions and temporary files under runs/e2e-deferred-2026-10-25; no external model calls or third-party writes.
